verdict.rationale: Lithic is fundamentally an API-first product (card issuance, authorization rules, disputes, webhooks, events, KYC, versioning all documented as API-driven), and the docs explicitly note there's no separate 'UI-only' path — actions like creating cards, configuring rules, and running transactions are described as API/MCP-executable. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms full parity between the Lithic dashboard UI and the API (e.g., whether all dashboard configuration, reporting, or admin actions are API-exposed), and no OpenAPI spec was found to verify complete coverage. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity confirmation, discoverable OpenAPI/schema proving full endpoint coverage, and evidence addressing dashboard-only features (if any) being API-accessible.
